rows.en: Run!
H-hey, stop dragging me!!
Alto-kun!
Stop right there!!
What idiot stops just 'cause you tell him to?!
Huff... huff...
Come on... Don't drag me into your mess.

That's what you get for egging them on.
Sheesh...
...Must be tough for those two, too.
rows.notes: Player sympathises with Ranka and Sheryl; Alto's reply (c00090) protests he has it worst.

rows.en: I'm the one who's got it worst, dammit!
Alto-kuuun!
There you aaare~
Gah!
Geez, just let them catch you already...
C'mon, we're making a run for it!
Get back here!
Hey! Don't you dare run away!!
(Leave me out of thiiis!)
(School's out, huh... I'm worn out again today.)
Yeah, fine by me, but...

I figured Michel-kun was the only one girls chase,
but you're no slouch either, Saotome-kun.
So, which one are you gonna hang out with?

Is this what they call a love-triangle
showdown...?
Come on... Don't drag me into thiiis...
Sigh... Must be tough for those two, too...
(Alto called me up to the roof, but...)
Glad you came.

Telling me to come wearing my EX-Gear...
What's going on?
Isn't it obvious? There's only one thing to do.
Come on, let's go.

Huh? Wait!
What's this all about?!
Feel the wind on your skin! Don't think!
I-I'm feeling it, okay?!
Fire the thrusters like you're handling a kitten!
I don't get that comparison...!
Now, punch it!
L-like this, right?!
Here we go!
Okay, okay!!
Huff... huff...
There's nothing left for me to teach you.
Um, I don't remember you teaching me anything...
...Words aren't necessary.

As long as we have the sky and our wings,
we can understand each other...
Isn't that right?
W-well, maybe, but...
What's gotten into you all of a sudden...?

...You've helped me out with a lot of stuff.
Think of this as my way of saying thanks.

I didn't know how I should thank you,
so it turned out like this.
Sorry if it was a bother.
Alto...
Take good care of that corkscrew I taught you.
See ya...
(I'd better practice it again before I forget.)
(Saotome-kun called me up to the roof, but...)
Huh? Wait! What, what?!
I really don't get that comparison...!
L-like this?!
Got it!!
Saotome-kun...
